manipulators.description: CapsLock = Escape when tapped, Hyper when held
Hyper + Control + I launch IntelliJ IDEA
Hyper + Control + X launch Codex App
Hyper + Control + C launch Codex CLI
Hyper + Control + L launch Claude Code
Hyper + Command + Option + H word selection
Hyper + Command + Option + L word selection
Hyper + Command + N delete to line start
Hyper + Command + period delete to line end
